rachael (Billing Ops): FYI two customers reported April invoices with usage lines showing $0 and in one case they received the same invoice_id twice. attaching quick extract. :confused:

rachael (Billing Ops): Extract (redacted):
```
Invoice: 2025-04-INV-2210
Customer: gamma-svc
Lines:
 - Reserved capacity: $600
 - Usage (tokens): $0  <-- expected $240
 - Tax: $48
 Total: $648
```

sam (FinOps): Do we know if the ledger charge was $240 or $0?

rachael (Billing Ops): Ledger shows $240 applied. So it's a rendering/attachment problem for some PDFs. invoices-bot reported duplicate invoice_id for a different customer in same batch.

invoices-bot: ALERT: duplicate invoice_id detected: 2025-04-INV-2203 (batch invoice_run_2025_04_30).

lisa (Payments): If PDF mismatches but ledger is correct, hold on emailing attachments while we investigate. I'll pause the sending job.

henry (Support): Customer reached out confused; they were charged correctly but have two PDFs, one missing usage. They're nervous. I can send a quick note if we have a remediation plan.

sam (FinOps): Quick triage query suggested by eng:
```
SELECT i.invoice_id, count(p.id) as pdf_count, sum(il.amount) as line_sum, u.usage_total
FROM invoices i
LEFT JOIN invoice_pdfs p ON p.invoice_id=i.invoice_id
LEFT JOIN invoice_lines il ON il.invoice_id=i.invoice_id
LEFT JOIN usage_aggregates u ON u.customer_id=i.customer_id AND u.period='2025-04'
WHERE i.period='2025-04'
GROUP BY i.invoice_id, u.usage_total
HAVING pdf_count>1 OR coalesce(sum(il.amount),0) <> coalesce(u.usage_total,0);
```

rachael (Billing Ops): Ran it: 4 invoice_ids with pdf_count>1, 7 invoices where sum(lines) <> usage_total. Renderer logs show: "WARN render_line(): template_missing for key 'usage_detail' when feature_flag 'compact_invoice_v2' = true"

sam (FinOps): That feature flag was toggled in the renderer last deploy. @deploy-bot, what rolled yesterday?

deploy-bot: Deploy event: invoice-renderer v1.14.2 -> prod at 1798762000 by ci/pipeline.

lisa (Payments): Please confirm pause complete. Also if duplicate invoice_ids exist, we need dedupe before any resend to avoid duplicate billing emails.

henry (Support): I'll batch notify affected customers with a short message: apologize, explain charge is correct, corrected PDF coming. Send list when ready.

sam (FinOps): Proposed next steps: 1) pause PDF email job (done) 2) pin renderer back to v1.14.1 or patch template handling 3) mark affected invoice records with status='pdf_needs_rerender' 4) enqueue re-render and resend. Also add regression test to renderer for feature_flag combos.

rachael (Billing Ops): I'll compile the affected invoice list and open FIN-2025-159. Assigning to eng-infra-renderer. Will update when re-render completes. :white_check_mark:
